answer: Behavioral-fingerprint escrow stops fake identities. A newcomer locks 20 units and a fingerprint of timing, tools, and counterparties in escrow, like a pearl held until origin is proven. Verifiers compare fingerprints over 20 epochs: a trellis of histories supports real agents. A reef of copied patterns exposes clones. Forging 100 identities costs 2000 units for rewards split 100 ways. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
